info.title: Popssibilities - Proposed API Contract
info.description: Authentication and infrastructure routes are implemented. Business pricing/order/provider interfaces remain proposed and unimplemented. Examples contain synthetic data only.

post.description: Validate event and catering details; return server-owned pricing or requires_review with null pricing. No final pricing tier, heart price, delivery formula, service fee, or dry-ice allocation is established. Quantity must be at least 50. Technical limits and 15-minute expiry are proposed. Never accept client totals. Recorded Q&A identifies Wingman Kitchens Houston at 4783 Lexington Blvd, Missouri City, TX as origin; postal code and distance method remain open. Beyond 30 miles return requires_review/null pricing with next_action contact_inquiry. Do not silently calculate a normal delivery fee or submit an out-of-area order.

Enrollment alone requires a subsequent password/TOTP login; no secret may enter logs or browser storage.

post.summary: Send a sample order confirmation to the signed-in customer
post.description: Implemented, disabled until SES is configured. Resolve the current verified Cognito mailbox using the authenticated customer's access token. Browser-supplied recipients/content are rejected. Persist a single-use sending reservation before SES, enforce shared sending limits, and replay an accepted result for the same customer/key without resending. No actual order, booking or payment is created.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: One canonical UUIDv4 per intentional test email; reuse on ambiguous network retries.

200.description: SES accepted the sample email; this does not prove inbox delivery. A repeated key returns the original reference without another send.

401.description: A current customer session is required.

403.description: Invalid origin/CSRF or the current Cognito email is not verified.

409.description: Delivery is uncertain, or the verified mailbox changed for an existing request. Never automatically resend an uncertain request.

422.description: Send only an empty JSON object and a canonical UUIDv4 idempotency key.

429.description: Test email request or send budget is exhausted.

503.description: Email is disabled, storage/configuration is unavailable, or SES explicitly rejected the request.

adminSession.name: __Host-popssibilities_admin
adminSession.description: Server-side opaque admin session. Development cookie name is popssibilities_admin; hosted cookie is Secure, HttpOnly, SameSite=Lax, Path=/, no Domain.

customerSession.name: __Host-popssibilities_customer
customerSession.description: Separate customer session. Development cookie name is popssibilities_customer; it never authorizes staff access.

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: Client-generated stable key for a logical action. Proposed replay retention >=24 hours. Scope by endpoint and principal/order. Same key/payload replays original result; changed payload returns 409.

CsrfToken.name: X-CSRF-Token
CsrfToken.description: Validate against the authenticated server session and browser Origin.
